Engineering thresholds and scores are provisional, not validated aesthetic accuracy.
UI acceptance used desktop Chromium at a phone viewport; physical Safari/Android, background, Bluetooth and lock-screen remain unverified.
Only one pair at two cue locations used for final public playback acceptance; this does not validate library-wide perceptual generality.
Render-quantum timing is not device output latency.
Existing dynamic EQ points are preserved but cloud DSP uses 64-sample coefficient blocks, not a bit-identical old browser render.
